evidence.description: The selected endpoint is force-unwrapped when constructing NetworkConfiguration.

candidates.explanation: The endpoint is optional, but its presence is not checked before using endpoint!. If the selected URL provider value is nil, constructing the analytics network configuration traps instead of handling the missing endpoint.
candidates.title: Force-unwrapped analytics endpoint

evidence.description: Initialization explicitly sets six autotracking properties after creating the tracker.
Updating the tracker replaces it through makeTracker without reapplying those properties.
Reset also replaces the tracker without executing the initializer's configuration.
The shared factory creates the tracker but does not apply the initializer's explicit autotracking settings.

candidates.explanation: Tracker configuration is split between the factory and the initializer. Both replacement paths omit the initializer-only autotracking assignments, so those paths do not enforce the same settings as initial construction. Whether the resulting settings match depends on configuration defaults rather than the explicit policy applied at initialization.
candidates.title: Tracker replacement omits initialization settings

evidence.description: The common tracking method excludes tracker.track calls when TESTING is defined.
The analytics-setting event calls tracker.track directly without the TESTING conditional.

candidates.explanation: The direct tracking path bypasses not only the consent check needed for the opt-out event, but also the test-build suppression used by the common tracking method. Consequently, this method can submit events to the tracker in TESTING builds even though ordinary event submission is compiled out.
candidates.title: Direct tracking bypasses test-build suppression
